events.title: Listen to the Screen
events.description: A three-part series about making visual art accessible to blind and visually impaired audiences. Oct 1: “Telephone” screendance screening and filmmaker Q&A at 537 Highland Ave. Oct 3: online audio description for dance workshop with Krishna Washburn. Oct 10: online audio description for films, animation, and dance workshop with Dr. Joel Snyder. Join links are below; QR codes are on the poster. Questions: l_xia@uncg.edu.
events.posterAlt: Listen to the Screen poster with bold black lettering, blue date panels, a filmstrip, a dancer, and a microphone. The three dates and event descriptions are also given in this listing.
